text: They have corrupted themselves: Heb. he hath corrupted to himself | their spot is not the spot of his children: Or, that they are not his children, that is their blot
many generations: Heb. generation and generation
led him about: Or, compassed him about
not to God: Or, which were not God
shall burn: Or, hath burned | shall consume: Or, hath consumed

within: Heb. from the chambers | destroy: Heb. bereave | our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this: Or, our high hand and not the LORD hath done all this | Meribahkadesh: Or, strife at Kadesh
of the vine of Sodom: Or, is worse then the vine of Sodom
your protection: Heb. an hiding for you
Rejoice, O ye nations: Or, Praise his people ye nations. Or, sing ye
